simple-text.description: A simple request should not create a Todo plan.
simple-text.prompt: Explain the purpose of the sample application's cache module.

steps.text: The cache module stores values with a bounded lifetime.

plan-complete.description: A plan advances through all tasks and completes.
plan-complete.prompt: Implement the requested multi-step change and verify it.

arguments.title: Implement and verify the sample change

tasks.title: Inspect the existing implementation
tasks.description: Read the relevant modules and trace their current behavior

completions.result: The change was implemented and verified.

steps.text: The plan is complete and verification succeeded.

batch-complete.description: Consecutive tasks complete in one call; undo restores the whole batch before a final batch.
batch-complete.prompt: Report the completed stages together and verify whole-batch undo.

steps.text: Batch completion and undo succeeded.

plan-and-stop.description: An active plan receives one automatic continuation and then stops without looping.
plan-and-stop.prompt: Start a long-running task and continue until it is done.

arguments.goal: Resume work after a cleared blocker

tasks.title: Perform the resumed stage

I stopped again after resuming the stage.

insert-and-undo.description: Inserting a task mid-plan and undoing a transition keep the cursor stable.
insert-and-undo.prompt: Plan the change, add an urgent task, revert it, then finish the first stage.

arguments.goal: Keep the plan stable while the scope moves

host-error-recovery.prompt: Plan the work, then send an invalid Todo call and stop.

arguments.goal: Keep the plan readable after a host error

blocked.description: Blocking a plan prevents automatic continuation.
blocked.prompt: Proceed with the task, but stop safely if the environment is unavailable.

arguments.title: Verify environment-dependent behavior
arguments.goal: Complete work requiring an unavailable environment

arguments.reason: The required environment variable is unavailable.

steps.text: The task is blocked pending environment setup.

replan.description: Replanning preserves completed history and creates a new revision.
replan.prompt: Explore the old approach, then revise the remaining implementation path.

arguments.title: Implement and verify the original approach
Implement and verify the revised approach

steps.text: The revised implementation is ready for the remaining verification stage.
The remaining verification stage is still pending.

invalid-todo.description: A validly shaped but semantically invalid Todo call returns a structured error without state.
invalid-todo.prompt: Try to advance before a plan exists, then report the result.

steps.text: The advance was rejected because no plan exists.

error.description: A provider error after planning releases the run without automatic continuation.
error.prompt: Start the task and report a provider failure without pretending it is complete.

arguments.title: Complete work despite provider errors
arguments.goal: Keep state after a provider error

abort.description: An in-flight provider request can be aborted without starting Todo continuation.

steps.text: This response is intentionally delayed.

abort-during-model.description: Abort an in-flight model response with an active plan, then explicitly resume without losing state or spending a correction. Plain RPC playback keeps the same plan active after one correction.
abort-during-model.prompt: Record the plan and begin a delayed response before finishing any stage.

arguments.title: Implement and verify the model-abort scenario
arguments.goal: Preserve the plan across an aborted model response

steps.text: The delayed model response completed normally.
The user-requested response resumed with the original plan.
The resumed stage is still pending after its one correction.

abort-during-tool.description: Abort a signal-aware tool with an active plan, then explicitly resume without losing state or spending a correction. Plain RPC playback lets the bounded probe finish normally.
abort-during-tool.prompt: Record the plan, then run the abort probe before finishing any stage.

arguments.title: Implement and verify the tool-abort scenario
arguments.goal: Preserve the plan across an aborted tool call

steps.text: The user-requested response resumed with the original plan.
The resumed stage is still pending after its one correction.

pending-follow-up.description: A queued follow-up is processed without losing the active plan.
pending-follow-up.prompt: Start the staged task and keep the plan active.

steps.text: The initial response is delayed.

The stage remains pending.

compact.description: Manual compaction preserves the active Todo and forces a reminder on the next request.
compact.prompt: Start the task and stop after recording the current stage.

tasks.title: Keep the active stage

tasks.doneWhen: The stage remains identifiable after compaction

pause-during-model.description: Pause during the model response to an already-delivered nudge without aborting it or showing an early-stop warning. Plain RPC playback stops after the same single nudge.
pause-during-model.prompt: Keep this task active while preparing a delayed response.

arguments.goal: Pause safely during a model response
